description: This file defines the PatientSearchCriteria class, which provides methods to construct database query criteria for searching Patients based on name, identifier, or attributes within the OpenMRS healthcare system. The class includes logic for different search modes, handling voided records, and pattern matching for identifiers and names. It interacts with Hibernate's CriteriaBuilder and JPA joins to build complex query predicates.

classes.name: PatientSearchCriteria
classes.description: Encapsulates criteria construction for searching patients based on name and identifiers, providing methods that generate Hibernate JPA predicates based on various modes of search (by name, by identifier, combined, etc.). It manages search modes, handles partial and exact matches, and incorporates database-specific patterns for identifier searches.

methods.name: prepareCriteria
methods.description: Constructs query criteria for searching patients based on name, identifier, and voided status, combining multiple predicates for name, attributes, and identifiers.

methods.name: getSearchMode
methods.description: Determines the search mode based on provided name, identifier, identifier types, and search flags.

methods.name: copySearchParameter
methods.description: Utility to prefer source value if target is blank, or target if non-blank.

methods.name: getMatchMode
methods.description: Retrieves the name matching mode (start, anywhere) based on global properties.

methods.name: replaceSearchString
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in search regex patterns with the actual search term or its substrings.

methods.name: preparePredicateForName
methods.description: Creates predicates for matching patient names, considering short and long forms, exact or partial matches, and voided status.

methods.name: preparePredicateForIdentifier
methods.description: Creates predicates for matching patient identifiers, supporting exact, regex, and pattern-based searches, including case sensitivity.

methods.name: prepareCriterionForAttribute
methods.description: Constructs predicates for searchable attributes attached to patients for advanced searching.
